title: ISO 20022 On-Chain Correspondence Receipt
description: Compose a receipt that records the asserted correspondence between an ISO 20022 payment message (pacs.008 / pain.001 / camt.053 / camt.054) and its on-chain settlement leg, with an optional external-rail reference attachment (SWIFT gpi UETR, Fedwire IMAD/OMAD, CHIPS UID). Asserted by mapping, not proven.
